DML.SELECT: SELECT driver_type_id as "driverTypeId", driver_id as "id", license_type_id as "licenseTypeId", license_value as "licenseValue", license_issue_date as "licenseIssueDate", license_expire_date as "licenseExpireDate", name as "name", surname as "surname", gender as "gender", date_of_birth as "dateOfBirth", country_id as "countryId", state_id as "stateId", region_id as "regionId", locality_id as "localityId", address as "address", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible", created_at as "createdAt", updated_at as "updatedAt" FROM conf.drivers WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
